messages:
lina: P1 escalation from Acme — their API requests in eu-west returning 403s after automated key rotation. Tokens look valid on client side. Raising thread.
ryan: On it. Any sample req/res or trace ids?
lina: Provided in support ticket: trace_id=tr_0a9f, sample header: Authorization: Bearer <token>

marta: quick look at introspect logs: eu-west-introspect shows 403 for tr_0a9f with error "scope_mismatch". But key service shows key id present. Possible cache mismatch between authn cache and jwks cache.
andre: Did we recently failover the auth-backend? I see a maintenance window earlier for eu-west failover at ~1745128000.
ryan: Yup, auth-pods were drained/failover. I suspect the new instance loaded cached keys but the prefix cache didn't update. Need repro steps.
supportbot: Customer impact: ~12 tenants, request rate dropped ~20% for eu-west. Ticket #12345.
lina: Repro steps from customer: 1) Use service token to call /v1/endpoint, 2) get 403 intermittently. Happens more on new deployments.
ryan: Hypothesis: token issuer has new kid; jwks endpoint updated but cache TTL still returning stale signing keys to introspect service. When introspect tries to verify token, it can't find public key mapping -> returns 403.
andre: Quick mitigation: force jwks cache refresh on auth instances and restart introspect workers. Steps:
```
# on auth leader
curl -X POST https://auth.euwest.internal/api/admin/refresh-jwks
kubectl rollout restart deployment/auth-introspect -n redwood-auth-euwest
```
marta: I'll run the refresh now.

deploybot: Deploybot: Started rolling restart of auth-introspect (deploy/auth-introspect) at sha=deadbeef.

marta: Refresh done, restarted pods. Monitoring logs for tr_0a9f.
ryan: Any change for the failing traces?
marta: I see tr_0a9f now succeeded (200) after restart. Also seeing fewer 403s in the last 5m.

lina: Let customer know we've applied a cache refresh and restarted introspect workers; ask them to retry and provide new traces if they see more 403s. Escalate to eng if it recurs.
andre: Long-term fix: ensure jwks cache invalidation paths on key rotation and improve propagation during failover. Add a pre-failover cache sync step to the runbook.
ryan: I'll create a follow-up runbook PR and add a canary for jwks propagation.

lina: Customer replied: retry worked for some apps, still intermittent on CD pipelines. They've provided new trace tr_0b1c. Keeping P1 until stable.
ryan: Ok, looking at tr_0b1c — it's hitting a different edge node that used an older auth instance. Hmm. I'm going to increase rolling restart parallelism to flush all nodes.

marta: Kicking a wider restart now. ETA 3m.

deploybot: Deploybot: Completed rolling restart of auth-introspect in 3m.

marta: Post-restart telemetry: 403 rate down to baseline. Customer confirmed pipelines flowing.

lina: Closing P1 with postmortem step: add explicit jwks sync during key rotation, monitor propagation lag, and update runbook. Thanks all :heart:
ryan: Adding postmortem entries and labeling with incident-auth-cache-mismatch.
andre: Filed follow-up ticket OPS-9876 for runbook + e2e test.
